notes: Lane QE (scenegraph D2 part 1): nGZSceneGraph::cBoundingVolumeBuilder is our class (src/sg/cBoundingVolumeBuilder.h, on our cGeometryBuilder base); this factory is its only hook, every other body is in effect through it. new 0x34, the constructor, answered as the cIGeometryBuilder. Tests: sg_bounding_volume_builder_slots (random calls through the three faces, persistence round trips, HasName over case-varied names) and sg_bounding_volume_builder_build (synthetic containers with positions, decoys, aliases, weights with NaN and ties, transforms; the meshes dumped).

name: nGZSceneGraph::cBoundingVolumeBuilder::Fill
notes: Lane QE, class and tests: 0xa85090's entry. One pass over the triangle-list groups with indices (named ones only when named-only) whose linkage has a position element: without bones the bounding mesh's triangles through the positions' alias list, with bones each triangle into the subset mesh of each distinct bone of its corners, corners in that bone's frame (compgeom RigidTransform3); missing meshes made at their sizes, existing ones rebuilt. Float exactness: positions and transformed corners dumped bit for bit. Mutants: 8 of 9 killed by sg_bounding_volume_builder_build (no clamp of a missing bone, the primitive type test dropped, the size one larger, the named-only test dropped, alias list 0 for the positions, the third corner untransformed, and in the position search 0xaeda40's repetition and block-format tests each dropped, the first after a test fix: its position decoys never had block format 2). Survivor: the third corner's used[2] test dropped, equivalent (used[2] is still -1 whenever it is read).
